nodes.text: 안녕하세요! 처음 보는 것 같은데, 이름이 뭐예요?
nodes.pron: annyeonghaseyo! cheoeum boneun geot gateunde, ireumi mwoyeyo?
nodes.trans: Hi! I don't think we've met. What's your name?

replies.trans: Hi, I'm Kim Minjun. Nice to meet you.
I'm Minjun. It's my first time here.

nodes.trans: Nice to meet you, Minjun! Where are you from?

replies.trans: Seoul. I've always lived in Seoul.
Busan. I moved to Seoul last month.

nodes.trans: Oh, I see! How do you like life in Seoul?

replies.trans: I love it. There are so many good restaurants!
It's nice, but I don't have many friends yet.

nodes.text: 민준 씨는 무슨 일 해요? 저는 디자인 일 해요.
nodes.pron: minjun ssineun museun il haeyo? jeoneun dijain il haeyo.
nodes.trans: What do you do, Minjun? I work in design.

replies.trans: I'm a college student. I major in business.
I work at an IT company.

replies.text: 영어 배우고 싶어서 언어 교환하러 왔어요.
replies.pron: yeong-eo baeugo sipeoseo eoneo gyohwanhareo wasseoyo.
replies.trans: I want to learn English, so I came for the language exchange.

nodes.text: 오, 멋있다! 쉬는 날에는 보통 뭐 해요?
nodes.pron: o, meositda! swineun nareneun botong mwo haeyo?
nodes.trans: Oh, cool! What do you usually do on your days off?

replies.trans: I like sports. I play soccer a lot.
I watch a lot of movies.
I like cooking. Mostly Korean food.

nodes.text: 와, 저도요! 친구들이랑 주말마다 축구하는데, 언제 같이 할래요?
nodes.pron: wa, jeodoyo! chin-gudeurirang jumalmada chukguhaneunde, eonje gachi hallaeyo?
nodes.trans: Wow, me too! I play with friends every weekend. Want to join us sometime?

replies.trans: Sure, let's definitely play together!
Hmm, I'm not very good, though.

nodes.text: 괜찮아요, 그냥 재미로 하는 거예요. 다들 잘 못해요!
nodes.pron: gwaenchanayo, geunyang jaemiro haneun geoyeyo. dadeul jal motaeyo!
nodes.trans: Don't worry, it's just for fun. None of us are very good!

replies.trans: Haha, then count me in!
Let me think about it.

nodes.text: 저도 영화 진짜 좋아해요! 어떤 영화 좋아해요?
nodes.pron: jeodo yeonghwa jinjja joahaeyo! eotteon yeonghwa joahaeyo?
nodes.trans: I really love movies too! What kind of movies do you like?

replies.trans: Action movies!
I like comedies. I like funny stuff.

nodes.text: 요즘 재밌는 영화 하던데, 같이 보러 갈래요?
nodes.pron: yojeum jaeminneun yeonghwa hadeonde, gachi boreo gallaeyo?
nodes.trans: There's a fun movie out these days. Want to go see it together?

replies.trans: Sounds good! When?

replies.text: 가고 싶은데, 이번 주는 좀 바빠요.
replies.pron: gago sipeunde, ibeon juneun jom bappayo.
replies.trans: I'd love to, but I'm a bit busy this week.

nodes.text: 진짜요? 저 요리 완전 못하는데, 김치찌개 만드는 법 좀 알려 줄래요?
nodes.pron: jinjjayo? jeo yori wanjeon motaneunde, gimchijjigae mandeuneun beop jom allyeo jullaeyo?
nodes.trans: Really? I'm terrible at cooking. Could you show me how to make kimchi stew?

replies.trans: Of course! Let's make it together sometime.
Sure. It's really easy!

nodes.text: 잘됐다! 이번 주 토요일에 시간 돼요?
nodes.pron: jaldwaetda! ibeon ju toyoire sigan dwaeyo?
nodes.trans: Great! Are you free this Saturday?

replies.trans: Yes, Saturday is fine.
Saturday is a bit hard for me. How about Sunday?

replies.text: 아직 잘 모르겠어요. 나중에 연락해도 돼요?
replies.pron: ajik jal moreugesseoyo. najung-e yeollakaedo dwaeyo?
replies.trans: I'm not sure yet. Can I get back to you later?

nodes.text: 그래요! 그럼 오후 세 시 어때요?
nodes.pron: geuraeyo! geureom ohu se si eottaeyo?
nodes.trans: Okay! Then how about three in the afternoon?

replies.trans: Sounds good. See you at three!

replies.text: 조금 늦게 만나도 돼요? 다섯 시쯤이요.
replies.pron: jogeum neutge mannado dwaeyo? daseot sijjeumiyo.
replies.trans: Could we meet a little later? Around five.

nodes.text: 딱 좋네요! 그럼 우리 카톡 친구 추가해요.
nodes.pron: ttak jonneyo! geureom uri katok chin-gu chugahaeyo.
nodes.trans: Perfect! Then let's add each other on KakaoTalk.

replies.trans: Sure, I'll give you my phone number.
Are you on Instagram too? Let's follow each other!

nodes.text: 괜찮아요! 그럼 일단 번호 교환해요. 언제든 연락 줘요.
nodes.pron: gwaenchanayo! geureom ildan beonho gyohwanhaeyo. eonjedeun yeollak jwoyo.
nodes.trans: No worries! Let's swap numbers for now, then. Message me anytime.

replies.trans: Sure, here's my number.
Sounds good. I'll text you later.

nodes.text: 그럼 주말에 봐요! 오늘 만나서 진짜 반가웠어요.
nodes.pron: geureom jumare bwayo! oneul mannaseo jinjja bangawosseoyo.
nodes.trans: See you this weekend, then! It was really nice meeting you today.

nodes.text: 민준 씨, 오늘 얘기 재밌었어요. 또 연락해요!
nodes.pron: minjun ssi, oneul yaegi jaemisseosseoyo. tto yeollakaeyo!
nodes.trans: Minjun, I had fun talking today. Let's keep in touch!
